gaps.title: Missing Material Management Endpoints
gaps.jtbd: When managing epidemiological materials, I want to update and delete existing records, so that I can keep the knowledge base accurate and relevant.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an existing material record, When a client sends a PUT or DELETE request to the Material API, Then the material is correctly updated or removed from the system.
gaps.reason: The brief explicitly requests 'управления эпидемиологическими материалами' (managing epidemiological materials). The Material API only supports reading and creating; Update and Delete are absent despite frontend UI elements assuming their existence.

gaps.title: Missing Authentication and Session Management
gaps.jtbd: When accessing the epidemiological knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that only authorized personnel can add, modify, or view sensitive protocols.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a user attempting to access the system, When they provide valid credentials, Then they are granted an authenticated session with appropriate role-based permissions.
gaps.reason: DOMAIN-STANDARD expectation: Any system designed for 'managing epidemiological materials, protocols, and data' inherently handles sensitive medical or institutional knowledge, which requires a standard login/session security model to prevent unauthorized tampering.
